FIXED, and it turned out to be two defects. (1) PLUMBING: the feat->feat expansion queue in build.ts was seeded with the character's FEATS and owned CLASS FEATURES only, so all 34 heritage-keyed entries in featFeatGrants.ts fired for nobody — Anvil Dwarf's Specialty Crafting, Battle-Ready Orc's Intimidating Glare, Sage Jotunborn's Additional Lore. Measured with the new scripts/grant-reach-check.mjs, which is now a guard in npm run verify: a grant-table key in a bucket the engine never seeds is delivered to nobody while every 'is it modelled?' query answers yes. The queue now seeds BOTH heritages, and the grantSources lane beside it now reads the second heritage too (it read only the first, so a versatile heritage's grantsFeats reached nobody either). (2) THE RECORD: new lane EXTRA_FEAT_TAKINGS — a grant that is a taking OF ITS OWN, surviving the dedupe and carrying its own separately-answered sub-choice, optionally gated on a heritage. Two rows: jotunborn-lore's Special ('if you have the sage jotunborn heritage, you gain the Additional Lore feat a second time for a lore of your choice') and sage-jotunborn's own printed Additional Lore. A sage jotunborn who takes the feat now holds THREE takings, which is exactly what their ability_block 44552 + 44563 produce. Deliberately an opt-in table and NOT the general rule 'a repeatable feat from a second granter is a second taking': scripts/probe-repeatable-grant-double.mjs shows a cloistered cleric owns both cloistered-cleric and first-doctrine-cloistered-cleric, one printed Domain Initiate on two ids, so the blanket rule would hand them a domain the book never printed. Also fixed the half that would have made the lane inert: a granted feat has no slot, so every unbound granted Additional Lore shared one bare 'additional-lore:0' key and two takings trained ONE Lore — the subject is now keyed '<grantedBy>#<variant>:<featId>:<idx>' (bare key still read), the Special taking skips the granter's BOUND answer, and Builder.tsx mounts a Lore input for granted feats, which it never did. test/jotunborn-lore-takings.test.ts (9).
